about_the_game:
Simple 2D 3d6 (six-sided dice) rolling system for Lights&Shades:Safìna - RPG.

Implemented the ability to reroll a single die of the three or to specifically choose a number among the three dice after the roll.

Very useful for keeping track of the results during the sessions.
detailed_description:
Simple 2D 3d6 (six-sided dice) rolling system for Lights&Shades:Safìna - RPG.

Implemented the ability to reroll a single die of the three or to specifically choose a number among the three dice after the roll.

Very useful for keeping track of the results during the sessions.
